story.fullStory:
Tosca's "Honey" — original release 2000. Suzuki is the second studio album by Austrian duo Tosca, released by Studio .

Artist: Tosca · Title: Honey · Album: Suzuki · Year: 2000 · Genre: Dub · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Tosca - Honey.mp4.

Unlike many of Tosca's subsequent releases, Suzuki is essentially an instrumental album, with vocal samples integrated throughout, but in such a way that they "become a part of the instrumentation."
The album is dedicated to the Zen master Shunryu Suzuki.

The dedication can be found on the inside of the front cover.

facts.text: Artist: Tosca · Title: Honey · Album: Suzuki · Year: 2000 · Genre: Dub · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Tosca - Honey.mp4
Suzuki is the second studio album by Austrian duo Tosca, released by Studio !K7 and G-Stone Recordings in 2000.

Unlike many of Tosca's subsequent releases, Suzuki is essentially an instrumental album, with vocal samples integrated throughout, but in such a way that they "become a part of the instrumentation."
The album is dedicated to the Zen master Shunryu Suzuki.
The dedication can be found on the inside of the front cover.
This is a discography of Tosca, an opera by Giacomo Puccini.
It premiered at the Teatro Costanzi in Rome on 14 January 1900.
Tosca has been one of the most frequently recorded operas, dating back to a nearly complete acoustical recording in 1918.
Tosca are an Austrian music group consisting of Richard Dorfmeister and Rupert Huber.
This is Dorfmeister's second such project, the first being Kruder & Dorfmeister.
